statement: I paint in oil because it lets me work slowly, building colour in layers until the light feels right. I sketch in pen because it is quick and honest: every line stays. Most of my paintings and sketches start from [subjects the artist paints] in and around [home city].
statementOptions: I paint in oil because it lets me work slowly, building colour in layers until the light feels right. I sketch in pen because it is quick and honest: every line stays. Most of my paintings and sketches start from [subjects the artist paints] in and around [home city].

I make oil paintings and pen sketches of [subjects the artist paints]. Oil gives me time: I can scrape back, repaint and build the surface over days. Pen is the opposite: fast, direct, and impossible to erase. Working in both keeps my eye fresh.

My work moves between two speeds. Pen sketches catch a moment quickly; oil paintings take [time] and many layers to finish. Both start from looking closely at [subjects the artist paints]. Prints and cards let more people take a piece of that home.
